description: Opens a three-lane forebear review of ANY artifact — a question, a needs list, a type schema, a search protocol, a prereg, a study result, a lineage record. Names the artifact, its type, and the claims it makes about itself; the review tests those claims and the three epistemic lanes, never the artifact the reviewers would have written.

artifact_path.description: Path to the artifact under review, as it stands.

artifact_type.description: What it is: a registered domain type slug, or a plain name (question | needs | competency-questions | layers | type-schema | search-protocol | prereg | board).

artifact_sha.description: A content address for the bytes reviewed, when one exists; else a file-bytes sha256 stated as such.

supporting_paths.description: What the artifact rests on and the reviewers may open: sources it cites, the types it must satisfy, the house rules, prior verdicts.

claims.description: What the artifact says about itself, verbatim. The review tests these; it does not restate them.
